_comment: Upper bounds for the CI benchmark's medians (Tests/PetrichoriOSUITests/PerformanceUITests.swift), read by .github/scripts/perf-gate.py. Calibrated on GitHub-hosted macos-26 (Debug build, iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator) over the first three runs, 2026-11-07: about 2x the worst observed median, so a gross regression fails and runner noise does not. NavigationTransition includes the fixed ~1 s zoom animation, so its headroom is absolute (+0.6 s of main-thread stall). Open Now Playing is bimodal on the runner (0.13-0.2 s or ~0.48 s per iteration), hence 0.8. Scroll_Deceleration is the fixed animation length and CPU Cycles/Instructions read 0 in the simulator: reported, not budgeted. Recalibrate from several runs' tables, never from one outlier.
